Dear Valued Supplier (Vendor 12169),

OQ Refineries LLC / OQ Refineries and Petroleum Industries (OQ RPI) invites your organization to submit a formal Technical and Commercial Offer for:

• RFQ Internal No: 6000061376 (Collective No: 9900048325)
• Scope of Work: Call-off Contract for the Recycling, Recovery and/or Reuse of Oligomer Waste at OQ RPI Suhar (Sohar) Polypropylene Plant
• Attached Documents:
   1. RFQ 6000061376.pdf (15 Pages — Commercial, Legal, HSE & General Conditions)
   2. SoW - Recycling of oligomer V3.pdf (8 Pages — Technical Scope, Lab Analysis, Mandatory Criteria & 100-Point Scoring Matrix)
• Submission Deadline: 20.08.2026 by 23:59:59 hrs via Tawreed Portal (www.tawreed.oq.com)
• IMPORTANT NOTICE: Do NOT copy the Procurement Officer when submitting your offer on Tawreed Portal, otherwise your bid will be rejected.

Best regards,
Marjun DOYOG
Procurement Officer
OQ Refineries LLC (Muscat / Suhar)

draft.body:
Dear OQ Refineries and Petroleum Industries (OQ RPI) Tender Evaluation Committee,

PGS Oman (Vendor Code 12169, JSRS Certified) is pleased to submit our complete Technical & Commercial Bid Package in response to RFQ No. 6000061376 (Collective No. 9900048325) and Scope of Work V3 for the Call-off Contract for the Recycling, Recovery and/or Reuse of Oligomer Waste at OQ RPI Suhar.

• Primary Commercial Offer (SoW Section 10): 85.000 OMR / Ton payable to OQ RPI within 7 calendar days of OQ RPI weighbridge invoice (Est. 11,900.000 OMR across 50T current inventory + 90T over 3 years).
• Alternative Service Rate (RFQ Clause 2.1): 110.000 OMR / Ton turnkey recycling service fee (30 days credit).
• Technical & Regulatory Compliance: 100% in-country fractional distillation at PGS Oman's owned & operated Sohar Industrial Estate facility under EA License #EA-WM-4092 & CDAA Permit #CDAA-SH-8821; 10-working-day collection SLA; 60-day recycling completion SLA; 90-day bid validity.

Sincerely,
Ahmed Al Kindi
General Manager · PGS Oman

emails.subject: RFP: 24-Month Waste Collection & RoRo Skip Contract at Duqm Freezone
emails.bodyText:
Dear Contracts Manager,

We are seeking a licensed environmental contractor for a 24-month waste management contract at our Duqm Special Economic Zone port terminal and warehouse complex.

Scope of Work required:
1. 10 x 1.1 CBM Galvanized Wheelie Bins for daily municipal solid waste collection.
2. 3 x 20 CBM RoRo containers for industrial timber, packaging scrap, and construction debris (approx. 10 trips per month).
3. 2 x 7 CBM chain-lift skips for workshop general waste (8 pulls per month).
4. Cardboard and plastic recyclable collection with monthly recycling diversion reports.

Kindly send us your commercial proposal with unit rates, Be'ah registration confirmation, and payment terms so we can present it to our tender committee this week.

Regards,
Eng. Salim Al-Rawahi
Procurement & Contracts Lead
Duqm Port Industrial Services LLC

executiveSummary: Google LLC needs waste collection at Ghala & Rusayl.

draft.subject: Quotation | Ghala & Rusayl waste collection
draft.body:
Dear Google,

Thank you for your RFQ. We are pleased to quote for your Ghala & Rusayl facilities for 12 months from 1 Nov 2026.

• General waste · 6 bins × 208: 1,248.000 OMR
• Cardboard · 2 bins × 240.500: 481.000 OMR
• 6 m³ skips · 2 lifts × 200: 400.000 OMR
Total · excluding VAT: 2,129 OMR/month

General waste: 3× weekly; cardboard: weekly; skips: 2 lifts/month. Payment: 30 days. Please confirm to arrange mobilisation.

Kind regards, Tuning AI
General Manager · PGS Oman

Our Sohar Industrial Estate plant requires an immediate annual service contract for:
